A '''fortress''' was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]].<ref name="Resurrection" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Resurrection (comic story)|Resurrection]]," in which the fortress appears, take place before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], and after the theft of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which took place during the [[Battle of Toprawa]] per ''[[Jedi Dawn]]''. Since the novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] establishes that the latter battle took place following the [[attack on the first Death Star]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' in turn dates to 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Battle of Toprawa must have also occured in 0 BBY, meaning the events of "Resurrection" are set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as well.</ref> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], along with two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], went to the fortress and faced the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], several individuals members of a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul and the Prophets were eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Darth Vader and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Resurrection" />
